Method of Attack: Remote code execution (RCE) vulnerability allowing unauthenticated attackers to execute commands on vulnerable Atlassian Confluence servers remotely
Exploitation to install cryptocurrency miners (e.g., XMRig Monero miners) on Windows and Linux Confluence servers
Potential lateral movement to drop ransomware payloads and exfiltrate data
Discoverer: Coalition Director of Engineering Tiago Henriques
Attack Vector: Unpatched Atlassian Confluence servers vulnerable to CVE-2021-26084 RCE exploit
Indicators of Compromise: Publicly released proof-of-concept (PoC) exploit six days after patch release
Deployment of PowerShell or Linux shell scripts on compromised Confluence servers
Installation of XMRig Monero cryptocurrency miners
